priorityList: Use Power Siphon if you have 1 or fewer stacks of Demonic Core.
Cast Hand of Gul'dan immediately if the Dominion of Argus buff is active.
Use Grimoire: Imp Lord, Grimoire: Fel Ravager, and Summon Doomguard on cooldown.
Cast Summon Demonic Tyrant when you have 5 Soul Shards.
Use Implosion if you have 6 or more Wild Imps and there are 3 or more targets.
Cast Hand of Gul'dan if you have 5 Soul Shards, or at 3 or more Soul Shards if the Demonic Tyrant cooldown is greater than 5 seconds.
Cast Infernal Bolt if you have fewer than 3 Soul Shards to generate resources.
Cast Demonbolt with Demonic Core procs if you have fewer than 4 Soul Shards, prioritizing targets without the Doom debuff.
Use Shadow Bolt or Infernal Bolt as filler to generate Soul Shards.
Use offensive trinkets, racials, and combat potions while your Demonic Tyrant is active.
